stories.title: Dode en gewonden bij explosie in Israël door onontplofte munitie

en.title: Death and injuries in Israel explosion from unexploded munitions
en.summary: An explosion near the Israeli kibbutz Yiftach killed at least one person and injured 24 others, including students and teachers on a school trip. Preliminary investigation indicates a student found and placed unexploded munitions in a bag, which subsequently detonated.

stories.title: Albert Heijn al bijna complete dag ontregeld door cyberincident, lege schappen dreigen

en.title: Albert Heijn disrupted nearly entire day by cyber incident, empty shelves threaten
en.summary: Albert Heijn supermarkets experienced significant disruptions due to a cyber incident affecting parent company Ahold Delhaize, potentially leading to supply shortages.

stories.title: Fatale explosie tijdens schoolreisje in Israël, leerling had onontplofte munitie in tas

en.title: Fatal explosion during school trip in Israel, student had unexploded munitions in bag
en.summary: One person died and 19 others were injured during a school trip in Israel when unexploded munitions a student placed in a bag detonated.

stories.title: Lege schappen dreigen bij Albert Heijn na mogelijke cyberaanval

en.title: Empty shelves threaten at Albert Heijn following possible cyberattack
en.summary: Multiple Albert Heijn distribution centers shut down due to an IT incident at parent company Ahold Delhaize, disrupting supermarket restocking operations.

stories.title: Terwijl Trump de oorlogskas van Poetin spekt, waarschuwt deze Amerikaanse generaal 'alles en iedereen' te vernietigen bij een aanval op de NAVO

en.title: As Trump bolsters Putin's war chest, American general warns to destroy 'everything and everyone' if NATO is attacked
en.summary: A U.S. general states that NATO forces are prepared to destroy all targets and combatants in response to an attack on a NATO member, with the statement coming as Trump increases pressure on Russia and Ukraine.

stories.title: Meerdere distributiecentra Albert Heijn liggen stil door digitaal veiligheidsincident, kans op lege schappen

en.title: Multiple Albert Heijn distribution centers halted by digital security incident, risk of empty shelves
en.summary: Several distribution facilities of supermarket chain Albert Heijn have suspended operations due to a cybersecurity breach, potentially causing shortages of fresh products in stores across the Netherlands.

stories.title: Aantal abortussen in Nederland vorig jaar licht gestegen

en.title: Number of abortions in the Netherlands slightly increased last year
en.summary: Abortion procedures in the Netherlands rose by approximately 1.25 percent in 2025 compared to the previous year, with the most occurring among women aged 25 to 34.

stories.title: De Marché des Enfants-Rouges, de oudste overdekte markt van Parijs, volledig verwoest door brand

en.title: Marché des Enfants-Rouges, Paris's oldest covered market, completely destroyed by fire
en.summary: The historic market built in 1615 located in the Marais district burned down completely overnight, though the Paris mayor pledges it will be rebuilt.

stories.title: Aantal abortussen licht gestegen: 'Vanuit de wetenschap niet te verklaren'

en.title: Number of abortions slightly increased: 'Not explainable from a scientific perspective'
en.summary: The Netherlands recorded nearly 40,000 abortions in 2025, representing a 1.25 percent increase from 2024 according to health inspection data. The cause of the rise remains unclear.

stories.title: Aantal abortussen opnieuw licht gestegen, nog maar weinig huisartsen schrijven de abortuspil voor

en.title: Number of abortions slightly increased again, few general practitioners prescribe the abortion pill
en.summary: Abortion numbers have risen again while the number of general practitioners dispensing abortion medication continues to decline.

stories.title: Oudste overdekte markt van Parijs in de as gelegd

en.title: Paris's oldest covered market destroyed
en.summary: The oldest covered market in Paris has been destroyed.

stories.title: Oudste overdekte markt van Parijs verwoest door nachtelijke brand

en.title: Paris's oldest covered market destroyed by overnight fire
en.summary: A fire destroyed Paris's oldest covered market during the night between Sunday and Monday, with no reported injuries.
